name: reactor-next-4-dialog-after-battle
description: #108 attempt 1 (diagnostic): from the first guard battle (snapshot battle), Circle every 30 frames until g_GameState reads field (as reactor-next-0-after-battle), then no input: wait until message window 0 opens (state 1..14; open_wait) and until it waits for Circle (state 6; done_wait). Reports window 0's pointerEnabled, window 1's state and the field ID. Looks for the opening's first spoken lines after the battle.

win0.description: g_WindowData[0] (0x80083274, config/symbols.main.us.txt; WindowData 0x30 bytes, include/game.h) .state at +0x2C (s16 as u16): 0 WSTATE_INIT (no window), 1 SHOW, 2 TXT (typing), 4 WAIT_ROW, 6 TXT_DONE (text shown, waits for Circle), 7 CLOSING, 9 INIT_NEXT, 13 PAUSE_TXT_UNTIL_OK, 14 WAIT_NEXT_WINDOW. Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@d4db3de3c3aaf61269e048cf3f6a458996290de0 (reference only, no code) include/game.h WindowState, src/field/field_dialog.c.
